question: How much improvement is gained from Adversarial Reward Augmented Maximum Likelihood (ARAML)?

answer.free_form_answer: ARAM has achieved improvement over all baseline methods using reverese perplexity and  slef-BLEU metric.  The maximum reverse perplexity improvement 936,16 is gained for EMNLP2017  WMT  dataset and  48,44 for COCO dataset.

Compared to the baselines, ARAML does not do better in terms of perplexity on COCO and EMNLP 2017 WMT datasets, but it does by up to 0.27 Self-BLEU points on COCO and 0.35 Self-BLEU on EMNLP 2017 WMT. In terms of Grammaticality and Relevance, it scores better than the baselines on up to 75.5% and 73% of the cases respectively.

title: ARAML: A Stable Adversarial Training Framework for Text Generation
answer_short: ARAML outperforms state-of-the-art text GANs with a more stable training process.
answer_rationale: The evidence states that experiments show ARAML can outperform state-of-the-art text GANs with a more stable training process, directly answering the question about the improvement gained.
